name: guilty-gear
description: Guilty Gear (mainly -Strive-, roster of Ver 2.02 dated 2026-07-01) names and systems. Characters: official Japanese names from the Arc System Works GGST JP site and English names from Dustloop. Moves: official English names from the Dustloop character pages (headings); Japanese forms for moves are from author knowledge and flagged in `unverifiedSrc` (the official command lists are images and were not read). confidence: verified = term and rendering both appear in the cited source(s); partial = English side verified, some source forms (see `unverifiedSrc`) not cross-checked; unverified = not checked. Strive 2.0 (2026-04-09) removed Wild Assault and changed the systems; older videos may still use the old names.

Costs 50% Tension. Four colors by timing: Red (during a hit's hitstop), Purple (during a move, outside the Red window), Yellow (in blockstun), Blue (neutral).
Strive Roman Cancel colour (Red RC). YRC = Yellow Roman Cancel, a defensive 'get off me' during blockstun.
Strive Roman Cancel colour (Purple RC). YRC = Yellow Roman Cancel, a defensive 'get off me' during blockstun.
Strive Roman Cancel colour (Yellow RC). YRC = Yellow Roman Cancel, a defensive 'get off me' during blockstun.
Strive Roman Cancel colour (Blue RC). YRC = Yellow Roman Cancel, a defensive 'get off me' during blockstun.
Combo-breaker (Psych Burst) that uses the Burst Gauge. Gold Burst = used in neutral/wakeup, Blue Burst = used during blockstun or hitstun.
Cancelling a move (jump cancel or Roman Cancel) to make the opponent burst, then blocking it and punishing.
Main resource of Guilty Gear: spent on Roman Cancel, Faultless Defense, Overdrives.
Gauge built by blocking; higher levels increase the damage the attacker deals and enable R.I.S.C. counter hits.
State granting free Tension and buffs (Gold Burst hit, wall break, ...).
